items.prompt: Two disjoint events each have positive probability. Are they independent?

options.text: Yes, because their names are different
options.why: Different labels do not establish independence.

options.text: Yes, because no overlap is the definition of independence
options.why: That is disjointness, a different property.

options.text: No; their joint mass 0 differs from the positive probability product
options.why: Independence requires equality of those masses.

options.text: The question is undefined for every finite sample space

items.explanation: Disjoint positive-probability events exclude each other, so knowing one occurred changes the chance of the other to 0.
